findings.summary: --allowedTools and --disallowedTools are variadic in the claude CLI. buildClaudeCommand renders the positional prompt as the last token right after the profile flags, so the prompt is consumed as another tool name. The planner would start with no initial prompt and the prompt would be added to the deny list. The new test asserts this exact ordering. Fix: put the prompt before the variadic flags, terminate options with --, or use the --disallowedTools=<list> form, and update the test.
